MATH 33A: Linear Algebra and Applications
Fall Quarter - Sample Syllabus (fictional, for testing)

Instructor: Dr. A. Example
Office hours: Tuesdays 2-4pm, Math Sciences 6100
Textbook: Linear Algebra and Its Applications (any edition)

Grading
Homework 20%, Midterm 1 20%, Midterm 2 20%, Final 40%.
Late homework is not accepted. The lowest homework score is dropped.

Course Schedule
Week 1: Vectors in R^n, vector addition and scalar multiplication, linear combinations and span.
Week 2: Systems of linear equations, row reduction, echelon forms.
Week 3: Matrix-vector products; linear transformations of the plane (rotations, shears, reflections).
Week 4: Matrix multiplication as composition of transformations. Midterm 1 (Friday).
Week 5: Inverse matrices; the determinant as an area scaling factor.
Week 6: Subspaces, basis, dimension; column space and null space.
Week 7: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors; characteristic polynomial. Midterm 2 (Friday).
Week 8: Diagonalization and change of basis.
Week 9: Dot product, orthogonality, orthogonal projections, Gram-Schmidt.
Week 10: Least squares and linear regression. Review.

Academic integrity: all submitted work must be your own.
